label: Hai Phong
short_description: Northern Vietnam's major port city, on the Cam River and a common gateway to Ha Long Bay and Cat Ba Island.
intro: Hai Phong's hotel coverage in this directory covers northern Vietnam's third-largest city, a working port on the Cam River around 120km east of Hanoi with its own French colonial-era core alongside a fast-growing business and industrial district. It functions as a practical gateway to Ha Long Bay and Cat Ba Island, both under an hour away by road or ferry, and Cat Bi International Airport sits close to the city centre. Hotels here mix international business travelers with visitors staging onward trips to the bay, so downtown proximity and transport links tend to matter more than resort-style amenities.
